title: Residue fields of a localization agree with those of the base
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $W\subseteq A$ a multiplicative subset and $\lambda:A\to A'$ a homomorphism of commutative rings which is a localization of $A$ at $W$: (a) $\lambda(w)$ is a unit for every $w\in W$; (b) every element of $A'$ is $\lambda(a)\lambda(w)^{-1}$ with $a\in A$, $w\in W$; (c) $\lambda(a)=0$ implies $wa=0$ for some $w\in W$ (for instance $A'=W^{-1}A$ with $a\mapsto a/1$). Let $\mathfrak q'\subset A'$ be a prime ideal and $\mathfrak q=\lambda^{-1}(\mathfrak q')$. Then: (1) $\mathfrak q$ is a prime ideal of $A$ with $\mathfrak q\cap W=\emptyset$; conversely, for every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset A$ with $\mathfrak p\cap W=\emptyset$ the ideal $\mathfrak pA'$ generated by $\lambda(\mathfrak p)$ is a prime ideal of $A'$ with $\lambda^{-1}(\mathfrak pA')=\mathfrak p$, and $\lambda(\lambda^{-1}(\mathfrak q'))A'=\mathfrak q'$, so $\mathfrak q'\mapsto\lambda^{-1}(\mathfrak q')$ is a bijection from the primes of $A'$ onto the primes of $A$ disjoint from $W$, with inverse $\mathfrak p\mapsto\mathfrak pA'$; (2) the composite $A\xrightarrow{\lambda}A'\to A'_{\mathfrak q'}$ is a localization of $A$ at $A\setminus\mathfrak q$ (in the sense of (a)-(c) with $W$ replaced by $A\setminus\mathfrak q$), so the ring map $A_{\mathfrak q}\to A'_{\mathfrak q'}$, $a/s\mapsto\lambda(a)/\lambda(s)$, is an isomorphism of $A$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]; (3) this isomorphism carries $\mathfrak qA_{\mathfrak q}$ onto $\mathfrak q'A'_{\mathfrak q'}$ and induces an isomorphism of fields and of $A$-algebras $\sigma:\kappa(\mathfrak q)=A_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak qA_{\mathfrak q}\xrightarrow{\sim}\kappa(\mathfrak q')=A'_{\mathfrak q'}/\mathfrak q'A'_{\mathfrak q'}$, where $\kappa(\mathfrak q')$ is an $A$-algebra via $A\to A'\to\kappa(\mathfrak q')$.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib IsLocalization.isPrime_iff_isPrime_disjoint to q' to obtain primality of its contraction q and disjointness from W. For every prime p disjoint from W, apply isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint and under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint to obtain primality of the extension and contraction of the extension equal to p.

Mathlib IsLocalization.map_under gives extension of contraction equal to q'. For BijOn comap, the preceding prime/disjoint equivalence gives maps-to; IsLocalization.orderEmbedding gives injectivity; and mapping p to its extension, with the preceding contraction identity, gives surjectivity.

Apply Mathlib IsLocalization.isLocalization_isLocalization_atPrime_isLocalization W to the localization of A' at q'. This specializes localization transitivity to prove that it is a localization of A at q. IsLocalization.algEquiv then gives e between the two localizations at q. Localization.localRingHom_unique identifies its ring homomorphism with the required canonical map, since e.commutes and the scalar-tower algebraMap identity give equality on A.

Rewrite both extended prime ideals as maximal ideals by Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal. IsLocalRing.map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal shows that e carries one onto the other. Use IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapAlgEquiv e for the A-algebra equivalence of residue fields; its mapAlgEquiv_residue identity proves compatibility with every residue class.

lean.statement: theorem prime_localRing_residueField_iso (A : Type u) (A' : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing A'] [Algebra A A'] (W : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization W A'] (q' : Ideal A') [q'.IsPrime] : let q := q'.comap (algebraMap A A') q.IsPrime ∧ Disjoint (W : Set A) (q : Set A) ∧ (∀ p : Ideal A, p.IsPrime → Disjoint (W : Set A) (p : Set A) → (p.map (algebraMap A A')).IsPrime ∧ (p.map (algebraMap A A')).comap (algebraMap A A') = p) ∧ q.map (algebraMap A A') = q' ∧ Set.BijOn (Ideal.comap (algebraMap A A')) {r : Ideal A' | r.IsPrime} {p : Ideal A | p.IsPrime ∧ Disjoint (W : Set A) (p : Set A)} ∧ IsLocalization.AtPrime (Localization.AtPrime q') q ∧ ∃ e : Localization.AtPrime q ≃ₐ[A] Localization.AtPrime q', e.toRingHom = Localization.localRingHom q q' (algebraMap A A') rfl ∧ (q.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime q))).map e.toRingHom = q'.map (algebraMap A' (Localization.AtPrime q')) ∧ ∃ σ : q.ResidueField ≃ₐ[A] q'.ResidueField, ∀ x : Localization.AtPrime q, σ (IsLocalRing.residue (Localization.AtPrime q) x) = IsLocalRing.residue (Localization.AtPrime q') (e x)
